definition_en: a serious event causing great damage or distress; a disaster
core_image: 洪水漫过村庄屋顶，人们挤上屋脊
scene: 洪水漫过堤坝，村人挤上屋顶呼救。The flood was the worst calamity in the valley's memory.
sceneCN: 这里 calamity 是「灾难、大祸」（第 1 个义项：造成重大损害的不幸事件）；句意是这场洪水是山谷记忆中最严重的灾难。

derivatives.zh: 由 calamity 加 -ous 构成，义为「灾难性的」
由形容词加 -ly 构成，义为「灾难性地」

senses.title: A great misfortune
senses.definition: an event bringing serious damage, loss or suffering
senses.definitionCN: 带来严重损害、损失或苦难的事件
senses.example: The earthquake was a calamity for the whole province.
senses.exampleCN: 这场地震是全省的灾难。
senses.why: Latin calamitas named harm and loss, first of crops, then of fortunes.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 calamitas 本指损失损害，先指庄稼，后指命运。

senses.title: Deep personal distress
senses.definition: a grave personal misfortune, as ruin or bereavement
senses.definitionCN: 重大的个人不幸，如破产或丧亲
senses.example: Losing the harvest meant calamity for the tenant farmers.
senses.exampleCN: 颗粒无收对佃农而言是灭顶之灾。
senses.why: The public disaster narrows to the household.
senses.whyCN: 公众灾难收窄到一家一户。

intro.en: Calamity comes from Latin calamitas, harm or loss, whose deeper origin is debated.
intro.cn: calamity 出自拉丁语 calamitas（损害、损失），其更深的来源尚有争论。

items.en: calamitas meant damage or loss, often to crops.
items.cn: 拉丁语 calamitas 意为损害、损失，常指庄稼受损。

items.en: some link it to calamus, a stalk, as if the stalk beaten down; this is a disputed guess.
items.cn: 有说法将其与 calamus（秸秆）相联，如被打倒的秸秆；此为有争议的猜想。

items.en: calamite carried the sense of misfortune into French.
items.cn: 古法语 calamite 把「厄运」之义带入法语。

items.en: calamity entered English for grievous misfortune.
items.cn: 十五世纪 calamity 进入英语，指深重的不幸。

items.en: calamity spans storms, wars and personal ruin, stronger than mere trouble.
items.cn: 如今 calamity 可指风暴、战争与个人破产，比一般的麻烦严重得多。

note.en: The look-alike group watches for the false friend calamari; the near-meaning group lists disaster words.
note.cn: 形近组警惕伪友 calamari；近义组是灾难类词。

entries.definitionCN: 炸鱿鱼，仅拼写相近，词源无关

entries.definition: an event causing great suffering or ruin
bad luck or an unlucky event

normalIntro.en: Picture the harvest beaten flat, and the family with it.
normalIntro.cn: 想象庄稼被压平，一家人随之遭殃。

normal.en: Latin calamitas means damage or loss.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 calamitas 意为损害、损失。

normal.en: Avert a calamity is a common phrase.
normal.cn: avert a calamity 是常用搭配。

normal.en: Calamari has nothing to do with it.
normal.cn: calamari 与 calamity 毫无关系。
catastrophe 是语义更重的近亲。

abstract.en: See the river swallow the fields in one grey sweep.
abstract.cn: 看河水一个灰浪吞掉所有田地。

abstract.en: Hear the silence after a collapsing roof.
Feel neighbours pull each other onto a rooftop.
abstract.cn: 感受邻里把彼此拉上屋顶。

examples.en: The drought brought calamity to the wheat belt.
examples.cn: 旱灾给小麦产区带来灾难。

examples.en: Quick warning averted a greater calamity.
examples.cn: 及时的预警避免了更大的灾祸。

examples.en: His sudden death was a calamity for the whole team.
examples.cn: 他的骤然离世是全队的巨大不幸。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「克·拉·没·堤」——洪灾一来，「克」得堤坝「拉」开，庄稼「没」了，只剩残「堤」。

root: calamity 源自拉丁语 calamitas「损害、损失」（一说与 calamus「秸秆」相关，指被打倒的秸秆，属存疑猜想），经古法语 calamite 进入英语；同族词 calamitous「灾难性的」同根。

sensesIntro.en: One Latin word for loss covers public disaster and private ruin alike.
sensesIntro.cn: 拉丁语一个「损失」，既指公众的巨灾，也指一家的破产。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: floodwater closing over a village.
core.cn: 核心意象：洪水漫过村庄。

branches.en: the flood that broke the valley
a ruined harvest, a household calamity
the public strike, the private ruin

intro.en: Calamity carries the Latin noun into English endings: -ity, -ous, -ly.
intro.cn: calamity 把拉丁名词带入英语词尾体系：-ity、-ous、-ly。

latinIntro.en: Latin calamitas, damage or loss, is the stem; its deeper root is debated.
latinIntro.cn: 词干是拉丁语 calamitas（损害、损失）；更深的词根存疑。
